document_overview: Single Excel quotation from Shree Balaji Corrugators (3 sheets: Quotation, Terms, Vendor Questionnaire) with 31 rate rows. Supplier serial numbers do not match RFQ line numbers, so mapping was done by size/ply/type. Some rates are per 100 Nos. A revised rate row for the 450x300x300 5-ply printed master carton appears at the bottom.
supersedes_note: Row 38 (Sl 31, SBC-5P-008A) '5 Ply Master Carton Printed (revised)' with remark 'revised rate' appears to supersede Sl 8 (SBC-5P-008) for 450x300x300 at Rs 41.5; the file does not explicitly state that it replaces the earlier row.

other_notes: MOQ: 1,000 Nos per size for printed items (Terms sheet B8).
Delivery: 10 working days from PO for regular items; 15 days for printed items (Terms B7).
Payment: supplier offers 45 days from invoice and explicitly declined 60 days (Q5).
ISO 9001 certificate was NOT attached; only 'available on request' (Q1 is must-pass with attachment requested).
Supplier serial numbers (Sl) differ from RFQ line numbers; partition rows are ordered 6-cell, 12-cell, 24-cell, which map to RFQ L20, L18, L19 respectively.
Supplier's Q3 capacity is stated in MT (assumed equivalent to tonnes).
extraction_warnings: L8 (450x300x300 5-ply printed) is priced twice: Rs 41.5 (row 15) and revised Rs 39.8 (row 38). Buyer must confirm which applies.
L3 rate Rs 1.63/Nos looks anomalously low versus adjacent sizes; possible typo. Reported as quoted.
Rows priced per 100 Nos: L5, L16, L23, L24 — not per piece.
L17 remark '2 pc' — unclear whether price covers tray+lid together; assumed but not confirmed.
BCT values not stated for L9, L10, L12, L14; construction (ply) and size match only.
Quantities were not provided by the supplier; quantity fields left null.
tax_text: Rates exclusive of GST @ 18% / GST @ 18% extra as applicable
lead_time_text: 10 working days from PO for regular items; 15 days for printed items
